description: This file defines the interface for the OcdmSession class, which manages DRM sessions using the OpenCDM library. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and callback handlers related to DRM session management within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: OcdmSession
classes.description: Represents a DRM session managed via the OpenCDM library, providing methods for session lifecycle, key management, and decryption.

methods.name: OcdmSession
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DRM session with system handle and client callback.

methods.name: ~OcdmSession
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the session.

methods.name: constructSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with specified session type and initialization data.

methods.name: getChallengeData
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data for license acquisition.

methods.name: storeLicenseData
methods.description: Stores license data received from license server.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an existing session.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the session with license response data.

methods.name: decryptBuffer
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted buffer.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Deprecated method for decrypting with additional parameters.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the session.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the session.

methods.name: cancelChallengeData
methods.description: Cancels ongoing challenge data processing.

methods.name: cleanDecryptContext
methods.description: Cleans up decryption context.

methods.name: destructSession
methods.description: Destroys the session.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a key by its ID.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Gets the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a key ID for the session.

methods.name: hasKeyId
methods.description: Checks if a key ID exists in the session.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets the DRM header.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code.

methods.name: handleProcessChallenge
methods.description: Static callback for processing challenge data.

methods.name: handleKeyUpdated
methods.description: Static callback for key status updates.

methods.name: handleAllKeysUpdated
methods.description: Static callback for all keys updated notification.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Static callback for error notifications.
